classification: DEFECT: host signature-decoder accepts noncanonical trailing bytes
claim: Host decodes the reference compressed signature encoding
witness: KAT 0 compressed payload has 615 bytes. Appending one zero byte preserves the polynomial returned by pre-fix decode_signature, but upstream crypto_sign_open rejects the signed message after adjusting its signature length prefix by 1.
control: Original unmodified KAT0 payload and signed message both decode and verify.
security_bridge: Decoder disagreement is local. build() validates the complete signed message with upstream C before Python decoding, and the guest takes an expanded polynomial rather than compressed bytes. No guest forgery follows from this witness.
fix: Require ceil(consumed_bits/8)==input_length before checking unused bits of the final byte.
novelty: Local host codec defect; no upstream vulnerability claim.
